content.text:
Yes. Here are reliable options around Tampines (with addresses and hours from their official pages):

- TSD Dental Group (Tampines) — 510 Tampines Central 1, #01‑250B/E (next to Tampines 1/Tampines MRT). Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm & 6–9pm; Sat 9am–4:30pm; Sun 9:30am–1pm. ([tsddental.com](https://www.tsddental.com/dental-clinic-tampines/))
- Advanced Dental — Tampines East: Blk 482 Tampines St 43, #01‑238. Hours: Sat–Sun 9am–5pm; most weekdays till 8:30pm. CHAS/MediSave accepted. ([advanceddental.co](https://www.advanceddental.co/clinics/advanced-dental-tampines-east/))
- Advanced Dental — Tampines North: Blk 614 Tampines North Dr 1, #01‑02. Often open on Sundays (check the week’s schedule on their page). ([advanceddental.co](https://www.advanceddental.co/clinics/advanced-dental-tampines-north/))
- Q & M Dental Surgery — multiple Tampines branches if you want a big chain:
  - Tampines 1: 10 Tampines Central 1, #04‑18/19
  - Century Square: 2 Tampines Central 5, #03‑16 (CHAS/MG/PG/MediSave accredited)
  - Our Tampines Hub: 1 Tampines Walk, #02‑89
  - Tampines North: Blk 633 Tampines North Dr 2, #02‑07
  (Check each branch’s hours when booking.) ([qandm.com.sg](https://qandm.com.sg/Clinic-Locator/EN))
- Family Dental Centre — Universal Dental, 479 Tampines St 44, #01‑231. Hours: Mon–Thu 8:30am–8:30pm; Fri 8:30am–5:30pm; Sat 8:30am–2:30pm. ([fdc.sg](https://www.fdc.sg/location/))
- Ease Dental — 824 Tampines St 81, #01‑34. Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–9pm; Sat–Sun 9am–5pm. ([easedental.sg](https://www.easedental.sg/contact))
